reason: I need full-site captures maybe three or four times a year, at a redesign or a handover, and the free tier's 15 pages on desktop and iPhone probably covers most of that. I'm not adding another subscription for something I'd use quarterly, and $79 lifetime from a brand-new tool with zero reviews is more than I'd gamble on a whim.
objection: Lifetime deals from unproven startups have burned me before: the tool goes quiet or gets sold a year later. And Studio caps me at 5 client sites, which is fewer than I actually look after, so even the lifetime deal doesn't really fit my agency.
would_change_my_mind: A lifetime deal around $49 that covers more client sites, with some real reviews or a public track record so I believe it'll still be running in two years.
